description: Ministry of Education - Order made under section 27(1) - Department of Information Technology (University of Ruhuna and Six Universities)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Education making orders under the Universities Act to amend departmental structures at multiple universities by adding "Department of Information Technology." While it mentions a government minister (Dinesh Gunawardena), it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content focuses on educational administrative matters - specifically university departmental structures - which falls under the Miscellaneous category as it deals with educational sector administration not covered by the specialized categories 4-9.
